text_en: The Redmi Note 10 is a series of mid-range Android smartphones developed by Redmi, a sub-brand of Xiaomi Inc., and launched in March 2021. Designed as the successor to the popular Redmi Note 9 series, it introduced significant upgrades in display technology, battery life, and camera performance while maintaining an aggressive price point, making it one of the most compelling value propositions in the smartphone market. The series included four variants: the standard Redmi Note 10, the Redmi Note 10 Pro, the Redmi Note 10 Pro Max, and the Redmi Note 10S, each targeting different user segments with varying specifications. The Redmi Note 10 Pro, for instance, featured a 108 MP main camera and a 120Hz AMOLED display, a rarity in its price range at the time. With over 3 million units sold in its first month, the series quickly became a global bestseller, particularly in markets like India and Europe, where affordability is a key factor in consumer decisions. The Redmi Note 10 also played a pivotal role in Xiaomi's strategy to dominate the budget and mid-range segments, leveraging its cost-effective supply chain and aggressive marketing to outpace competitors like Samsung and Realme.

Le Redmi Note 10 Pro, par exemple, se distinguait par son capteur principal de 108 MP et son écran AMOLED à 120 Hz, une rareté dans cette gamme de prix à l'époque. Avec plus de 3 millions d'unités vendues dès son premier mois, la série est rapidement devenue un best-seller mondial, notamment en Inde et en Europe, où le prix reste un critère décisif pour les consommateurs. Le Redmi Note 10 a également joué un rôle clé dans la stratégie de Xiaomi pour dominer les segments budgétaires et milieu de gamme, exploitant sa chaîne d'approvisionnement économique et un marketing agressif pour devancer des concurrents comme Samsung et Realme.
